name: smwpatches-boost-overworld-events-for-sa
title: Boost Overworld Events (for SA-1)
description:
SA-1 speeds up a lot of the Overworld processes, with the exception of events which will still lag a lot if using the event path fade effect. This patch fixes that. Note that they will run so smoothly, that the fade effect will be barely noticeable: you can use this tweak to slow them down so it becomes noticeable.
Don't patch this if you're not using SA-1 and you're not using the event path fade effect.
